title: Data Analyst, Intern
description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works. About the team Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background. What you’ll do As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous data analysts and scientists in the industry. You'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. Responsibilities Analyze data and running experiments to drive impact Ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly Create metrics, reports, and dashboards to inform and run the business Extend Stripe’s metrics semantic layer Build new data assets and improve existing data assets to support decision-making, products, and business processes Assess the impact of decisions, product launches, and product improvements using business analytics and A/B testing Learn quickly by asking great questions, finding how to work with your mentor and teammates effectively, and communicating the status of your work clearly Present your work to the Data Science team, partner teams, and fellow interns Who you are Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty. Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus. Minimum requirements Enrolled in a quantitative Bachelor’s or Master's degree program (e.g. Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, etc.) with the expectation of graduating in December 2027 or spring/summer 2028 Experience with SQL Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding Experience communicating and collaborating with multidisciplinary stakeholders in a team environment Preferred qualifications Experience writing and debugging data pipelines Demonstrated ability to evaluate and receive feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders via experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects Ability to learn new systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts

title: Technical Consulting Intern

This internship is designed for students from a range of technical disciplines who enjoy problem-solving, exploring technology, and understanding how systems, data, and business processes work together. You’ll gain hands-on experience supporting client engagements, collaborating with experienced consultants, and contributing to technology-driven initiatives. Whether your interests lie in software development, data analytics, systems design, or emerging technologies, you’ll have opportunities to apply your knowledge while developing practical consulting skills. What You’ll Do Support technology and digital transformation projects across banking, payments, capital markets, and wealth management. Assist with analyzing technical systems, business processes, data flows, and opportunities for improvement. Contribute to technical research, data analysis, dashboards, prototypes, or other technology-related deliverables. Collaborate with project teams to gather requirements, document findings, and support the design of practical solutions. Prepare clear presentations, documentation, and research materials to communicate technical findings and recommendations. What We’re Looking For Currently pursuing a degree or diploma in technical disciplines such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. An interest in technology, analytical thinking, and solving practical problems. Ability to understand technical concepts and communicate ideas clearly to different audiences. Exposure through coursework, personal projects, or other experiences to programming, data analysis, technical tools, or systems and processes. A collaborative approach, willingness to learn, and ability to contribute effectively in a team environment. Bonus Points For Interest in financial services, fintech, consulting, or digital transformation. Familiarity with programming languages or technical tools such as Python, SQL, Java, Excel, or data visualization platforms. Experience/familiarity with LLMs or AI tools such as GPT, Codex, Gemini, or Copilot. Experience with academic projects, internships, hackathons, or collaborative technical assignments. Curiosity about emerging technologies, cloud platforms, automation, or modern software and data solutions. Interest in exploring new technologies and applying technical knowledge to business challenges. Why Join Capco Gain hands-on experience contributing to real consulting engagements with leading financial institutions. Learn from experienced consultants and develop practical technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Explore different areas of technology consulting, including software, data, systems, and digital transformation. Work in a collaborative, non-hierarchical consulting culture where your ideas and contributions are valued. Build professional connections and develop skills that support future internship and full-time career opportunities. Compensation The salary range for this position is CAD $23–$25 per hour. Why This Role Is Open We are currently hiring for this role due to an existing or newly created vacancy within our organization. This position is open as part of our ongoing business needs, and we are actively reviewing applications to fill this role with a qualified candidate who can make an immediate impact. The posting expires on November 13, 2026. Inclusion at Capco We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day. Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination. AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

title: Business Development Associate, Field Service

description: Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Business Development Associate who will be responsible for driving new and expansion revenue within our small and medium-sized business (SMB) customer segment, helping fleets of 5 to 50 vehicles discover how Geotab can transform their operations. This is an exciting early-career sales opportunity for someone who thrives in front of customers, delivers engaging product demonstrations, and is ready to grow their career with industry-leading coaching. If you love connecting with customers and showcasing technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! What you’ll do: As a Business Development Associate your key area of responsibility will be achieving an individual Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth target by managing an assigned list of SMB leads, accounts, and opportunities. You will be responsible for prospecting and qualifying new opportunities, engaging inbound leads in your territory, running discovery conversations to understand each customer’s fleet challenges, and delivering clear, compelling presentations and live product demonstrations that connect customer needs to the right Geotab solutions. Customer demos are a central part of this role, so you will spend much of your time showing prospects how Geotab works in practice. You will also need to advance opportunities through partner and referral programs, keep opportunity stages, activities, and next steps accurate in Salesloft and Salesforce, and build your knowledge of telematics, fleet management, competitors, and market trends. You will need to work closely with Business Development leadership, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, and Marketing to progress opportunities and share customer and market insights that shape planning and forecasting. Our ideal candidate is able to support customers in the Pacific time zone. To be successful in this role you will be a confident communicator and presenter who is coachable, resilient, curious, and motivated by measurable goals. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong organization and time management skills, the ability to learn technical and business concepts quickly, and the drive to build the product, industry, and sales expertise needed to progress into a Business Development Representative role. How you’ll make an impact: Manage an assigned list of SMB accounts and sales opportunities, typically serving fleets with 5 to 50 vehicles but may differ by segment. Use established partner and referral programs, including emerging SMB initiatives, to generate qualified pipeline and advance standard SMB opportunities through the sales process at high velocities. Deliver clear presentations, product overviews, and demonstrations appropriate to the customer's needs. Build working knowledge of telematics, fleet management, Geotab products, and common SMB fleet challenges. Prospect for and qualify new logo opportunities and identify expansion opportunities within existing SMB accounts. Execute account and opportunity plans for assigned SMB prospects using approved phone, email, digital, partner, referral, and other established selling motions. Use established discovery questions to understand customer needs, fleet challenges, and buying processes, and connect standard requirements to relevant Geotab solutions. Maintain accurate opportunity stages, next steps, activities, and close dates in Salesloft and SFDC; seek guidance on complex or non-standard requirements. Collaborate with Business Development leadership, Revenue Operations, Partner Account Managers, Marketing, and other cross-functional stakeholders to progress opportunities and follow established sales practices. Engage all inbound leads assigned for your territory and manage conversion & reseller referral process. Develop awareness of competitors, market trends, and segment-specific sales narratives. Seek coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve prospecting, discovery, negotiation, and closing skills. Share relevant customer and market observations with the team to inform established planning, competitive analysis, and revenue-forecasting processes. Work collaboratively with partners and cross-functional teams, and use developing AI capabilities to improve research, prospecting, preparation, and selling efficiency. Use customer and market research to identify opportunities and understand SMB fleet pain points. Build the product, industry, and competitive expertise needed to progress into a Business Development Representative role. What you’ll bring to this role: Post-secondary diploma or degree, with a Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business , Commerce, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and work experience may be considered. 1–3 years of experience in sales, business development , customer development , account management, customer service, or a related customer-facing field; relevant internships or co-op experience may be considered. Strong communication, listening, research, and relationship-building skills, with confidence delivering presentations and product demonstrations. Comfortable with prospecting, outreach, discovery conversations, and follow-up, with strong organization, time management, and attention to detail across multiple opportunities. Coachable, resilient, curious, and motivated by measurable goals, with a demonstrated interest in building a career in business development and sales. Familiarity with Salesloft, Salesforce, or other CRM and sales engagement tools, and comfort using AI to improve research and selling efficiency, is an asset. Occasional travel for team, customer, and partner meetings, training, and industry events; a valid passport is required for international travel. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. This posting is for an existing vacancy. Why job seekers choose Geotab: Flex working arrangements Home office reimbursement program Baby bonus & parental leave top up program Online learning and networking opportunities Electric vehicle purchase incentive program Competitive medical and dental benefits Retirement savings program *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only How we work: At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy . Click here to read our Privacy Notice. The On-Target Earnings (OTE) range for this position represents the total expected annual compensation, consisting of a base salary and commission/incentives. This may be subject to change. Geotab offers various perks and benefits and other compensation components that an individual may be eligible for. The actual salary for this position depends on a variety of factors such as but not limited to skills, qualifications, education and overall experience, including the location the applicant lives while performing the job. This also includes equity with other team members and alignment with local market data. All offers of employment are contingent upon proof of eligibility to work and the individual's ability to pass a background check. On-Target Earnings (OTE) Range $110,000 — $160,000 CAD

title: Global Operations Intern
description: Who we are: Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Who you are: We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Global Operations Intern (Product Ops Focus) who will play a hands-on part in maintaining data accuracy across our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, smoothing out product labeling workflows, coordinating international test device deployments and providing general operational project support to our internal teams and external partners. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you! What you'll do: As a Global Operations Intern (Product Ops Focus) your key area of responsibility will be maintaining ERP data and SKU accuracy, assisting with product labeling and workflow resolution, coordinating import and customs logistics, and supporting new product testing setups and partner engagement. You will need to work closely with internal teams, external regional partners, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and project leads. To be successful in this role you will be an enthusiastic, resourceful, and proactive self-starter with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, an operational mindset, familiarity with ERP systems and Excel/Google Sheets, and an excellent understanding of AI in day-to-day operational practice. How you'll make an impact: Audit and maintain SKU catalog accuracy across core ERP platforms; identify, troubleshoot, and re-catalog missing or dropped SKUs to ensure unbroken order fulfillment and reporting. Assist with product labeling governance by implementing and documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs) based on established solutions. Perform routine system health checks to ensure operational data consistency across warehousing and dispatch systems. Assist in securing local regulatory permits and clearance documentation required for importing hardware, with a specific focus on specialized test devices entering Singapore and other APAC regions. Monitor shipment trajectories and ensure seamless hand-offs between freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams. Coordinate logistics and hardware provisioning for new product evaluations and trial runs. Serve as a central communications point for external partners and internal team members participating in product test phases. Track test unit distribution, log partner feedback, and aggregate status reports for project leads. Gap analysis completed across 100% of active SEA partners within first 6 weeks. Partner account register maintained and updated monthly. Identified SKU gaps remediated within agreed timeframe. SKU enablement requests actioned within 1 business day. Shipping concession status confirmed for all eligible partners within first 8 weeks. Action registers maintained and up to date across all assigned SEA projects. Deliverable tracking & follow ups completed proactively - with status reported to Senior PM. Alpha/beta testing support - 100% of units tracked with log maintained throughout the program. Manage label rework initiative with no outstanding requests. Shipping cost recovery cases logged and followed up within agreed timeframe. What you'll bring to this role: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Excellent understanding of AI in day to day operational practice, Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, or similar), Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, pivot tables), and data management principles. Strong attention to detail with an ability to trace missing system data and follow through on resolution workflows. Excellent written and verbal communication in English to effectively coordinate with regional partners and cross-functional teams. Resourceful and proactive in navigating customs requirements, permit applications, and device distribution logistics. If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees. Why job seekers choose Geotab: Flex working arrangements Home office reimbursement program Baby bonus & parental leave top up program Online learning and networking opportunities Electric vehicle purchase incentive program Competitive medical and dental benefits Retirement savings program *The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only How we work: At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology! We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy .
